system.description:
You control a piece of metal at range.

Until the start of your next turn, you can lift and manipulate a piece of metal large enough to fill a 1/2 space cube at a rate of 10 spaces per round.

You can use this to make a melee attack at range, using a weapon or an improvised weapon, so long as the target is within 10 spaces. If you do so, you use your Mind instead of your Body on the attack roll.

If you try to take an object away from another creature, it must make an opposed Resilience check to keep hold of the object.

Other uses of this spell include ripping the hinges off a door or levitating a ring of keys across a room.

If you do not move the object, you may instead spend the turn exercising fine control over its movements, such as turning a key in a lock.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 rounds.

When the spell ends, the animated object falls to the ground, or may be retrieved by you so long as it is within your reach.
